name: OpenCode Fleet
description: Orchestrate OpenCode across multiple remote OpenClaw nodes (dev2, dev3, ...). Dispatch coding tasks, check fleet status, abort runaway sessions, and pull diffs over the authenticated node channel.

nodePrefixes.description: Fallback: prefixes treated as fleet members when nodes is not configured

user.description: SSH login user for this node (defaults to the SSH config default, usually root).

serviceUser.description: Principal the node's OpenClaw service runs as, when it differs from the login user. Install/verify target this principal's plugin root.

maxConcurrent.description: Max concurrent runs the gateway will start on this node (issue #39). A dispatch at the limit returns a retryable no-capacity result. Overrides capacity.maxConcurrentPerNode.

capacity.description: Concurrency slots (issue #39). Slots are counted from the gateway's run ledger; see fleet_capacity.

maxConcurrentPerNode.description: Default max concurrent runs per node. Unset means unlimited.

staleAfterMs.description: A run still `running` in the ledger after this long without an update stops holding a slot and is reported as suspected stale.

allowAutoApprove.description: Allow fleet_dispatch autoApprove (opencode --auto). Set false to forbid it fleet-wide.

allowSetupCommands.description: Allow fleet_provision setup to be an arbitrary shell command. Default: repo-relative script path only.

env.description: Refine the dispatch env policy. Built-in denials (BASH_ENV, NODE_OPTIONS, LD_*, ...) always apply.

allowOnly.description: If set, only these variable names may be injected.

isolation.description: Default per-run isolation for fleet_dispatch (issue #41). `clone` gives every run its own git clone on branch fleet/<runId> (own .git, hooks disabled), so concurrent runs cannot clobber each other. Needs a protocol-4 node (an older node is refused, never silently run un-isolated).

project.description: Design gate for spec dispatches (issue #117). A deterministic check (no model call) of the spec before dispatch: missing acceptance/verify/scope, a spec too large for one task, overlap with in-flight runs on the same checkout. `advise` (default) attaches the verdict as `design` when it is not a plain accept; `enforce` also refuses dispatch while an unacknowledged blocking objection remains; `off` skips it. A prompt-only dispatch is never gated.

maxScopePatterns.description: A spec with more scope patterns is `decompose`.

maxAcceptanceItems.description: A spec with more acceptance items is `decompose`.

roots.description: Directories on the gateway host under which fleet_project_show may read a checkout's .fleet/ record (issue #114). Default: the gateway's working directory and root dir.

rules.description: Operator project rules (issue #114), same shape as .fleet/rules.yml entries but `block` is allowed. A repo can add rules and tighten severity, never weaken or redefine these.

requireCharterFields.description: Charter fields every project record must have; a repo cannot drop them.

allowRepoBlocking.description: Let a repo's `block-candidate` rules actually block. Default false: they only advise.

s1.description: S1 decision layer (issue #79). Defaults: backend local-kev, mode shadow (decisions are logged, never acted on). A hosted or non-loopback backend sends data off this machine only when its allowEgress is true, with secrets redacted. A failure or an off layer always leaves the static rules in force.

thresholds.description: Per-question block thresholds (block when probabilityTrue >= threshold), from the #78 calibration report.

calibration.description: The model/version the thresholds were measured with. A different model reported at runtime downgrades enforce to shadow until re-calibrated.

url.description: Base URL of the S1 endpoint (local-kev defaults to http://127.0.0.1:8009).

apiKey.description: Bearer token for hosted backends. Never logged.

allowEgress.description: Opt in to sending (redacted) data to this backend when it is not loopback.

sync.description: fleet_sync publish policy: protected branches are never pushed directly (work is redirected to fleet/<name>) unless listed in allowDirectPush.

blockOnScopeViolation.description: Refuse fleet_sync for a run that changed files outside its declared spec.scope, or whose scope was never checked (issue #104). Override per call with allowScopeViolations.

requireReview.description: Refuse fleet_sync unless a fleet_review PASS is recorded for the exact head sha passed as `head` (issue #178). A PASS for an older sha does not count.

requireVerified.description: Refuse fleet_sync for work with no verification result (a run that did not use expect/spec.verify). A run whose gate FAILED is always refused unless allowUnverified is passed.

allowSensitivePaths.description: Allow worker changes to CI/CODEOWNERS paths.

sensitivePaths.description: Extra path globs treated as sensitive (e.g. ci/**), added to the built-in list.

apertureUrl.description: Model catalog URL (OpenAI-style /v1/models). No default: fleet_models and live model resolution are unavailable until set.

fleetRoot.description: Shared workspace root on nodes, used as the default provisioning cwd. Default: /home/<serviceUser>/fleet when every target node names the same service user.

piDefaultModel.description: Pi model ref (provider/id) used when harness=pi and the dispatch names no piModel. No built-in default.

ssh.description: SSH client policy for manager-to-node commands.

strictHostKeyChecking.description: accept-new trusts a host key on first contact (TOFU) and refuses changes; yes requires the key to already be in known_hosts (pin keys when you provision nodes).
